definitions: To risk everything by investing all of one's resources or hopes in a single venture or option.
To concentrate all of one's efforts or resources in one area, thereby increasing vulnerability to failure.
examples: Don't put all your eggs in one basket by only applying to one college.
She decided to diversify her investments, not wanting to put all her eggs in one basket.
It's risky to put all your eggs in one basket when starting a new business.
